001package services;
002
003/** Publishes and removes news items via the central {@link Database}. */
004public class NewsService {
005    private static NewsService instance;
006    private final Database db = Database.getInstance();
007
008    private NewsService() {}
009
010    public static NewsService getInstance() {
011        if (instance == null) instance = new NewsService();
012        return instance;
013    }
014
015    public void postNews(String title, String body) {
016        String t = title == null ? "" : title.trim();
017        String b = body == null ? "" : body.trim();
018        String text = t.isEmpty() ? b : (b.isEmpty() ? t : (t + ": " + b));
019        if (text.isBlank()) return;
020        db.addNews(text);
021    }
022
023    public void deleteNews(String newsId) {
024        // current DB stores news as plain strings; treat id as an index
025        if (newsId == null) return;
026        try {
027            int idx = Integer.parseInt(newsId.trim());
028            if (idx < 0 || idx >= db.news.size()) return;
029            db.news.remove(idx);
030            db.save();
031        } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {
032        }
033    }
034}
035
